description: Use this when ask_arn or start_ultradeep said an answer is still being written, or the user wants it again: it reads that question's answer by the question_id they gave: the answer with its numbered sources once it is written, or where it stands while it is written. Waits up to 20 seconds for a short answer that is nearly done; an Ultradeep review takes several minutes.

question_id.description: The question_id ask_arn or start_ultradeep gave.

name: get_ask_answer
